translations.web: Or don’t you know that he who is joined to a prostitute is one body? For, “The two”, he says, “will become one flesh.”
translations.bsb: Or don’t you know that he who unites himself with a prostitute is one with her in body? For it is said, “The two will become one flesh.”
translations.kjv: What? know ye not that he which is joined to an harlot is one body? for two, saith he, shall be one flesh.
translations.asv: Or know ye not that he that is joined to a harlot is one body? for, The twain, saith he, shall become one flesh.
